mission.title: Buffer Overflow
mission.description: Shut down Network Mainframe to access vital data.

phase.briefing:
I am glad to hear from you. I have an interesting assignment that should provide a bit of excitement.
You will be breaking into a nearby building that is crawling with programs, stealing access codes to a mainframe, shutting down the mainframe and then pulling data from the network. Once you've pulled that off, you will be updated with the rest of your assignment. I wish you well, Warrior!

enter.say: This is where you can find the mainframe. I'll be watching to make sure everything goes smoothly.

objective.text: Get the access codes to the mainframe
Get the data from the mainframe

phase.briefing: I've given you the location where the crew is waiting for you. Just make your way there and take over as leader for the strike.

enter.say: This is where you will find the Zion operatives. The captain's name is Pollux.

objective.text: Lead the Captain and Nunki out of the area

phase.briefing: Make your way to the Merovingian base. The address is being sent to you now.

enter.say: Search each computer you find. Once the primary mission objectives are completed, get your men out of the base.
